reason: This looks like a broad optimizer-semantics refactor, not a local cleanup. A shared expression column-extraction helper is being changed across central planner paths: selectivity/cardinality, join reorder, aggregation pushdown, plan building, physical agg, and functional-dependency logic. Subtle changes in which columns are discovered can alter plan legality, cost estimation, or rewrite behavior across many query shapes, so it is central and risky enough for a Blocker/High-focused deep review.
